name: support-ticket-resolution
description: Customer-support queue: an agent drafts a resolution, a support lead QAs it, then a router acts on the verdict — escalate genuine bugs to engineering, revise-and-recheck if the draft needs work, or finalize and send when it's good. Showcases a draft → QA → `route`-on-verdict pattern where the routing decision is driven by an upstream agent's judgement rather than the raw input.

inputs.name: ticket
inputs.description: The customer support ticket — the issue in the customer's words, plus any context.

phases.name: draft
qa
act-on-verdict
phases.description: escalate → package for engineering. edit → revise and the lead's notes get applied. default (send) → finalize the customer-ready reply.

escalate.name: engineering-escalation

edit.name: revise

default.name: finalize-and-send
